title: 90-day activation rate for 2024 signups
prompt: Of the customers who signed up in 2024, what fraction placed at least one completed order within their first 90 days?
metricDefinition: customers (signed up in 2024) with ≥1 completed order within 90 days of their signup_date, divided by all customers who signed up in 2024.
transformationPlan: identify customers who signed up in 2024
for each, check for a completed order between signup_date and signup_date + 90 days
referenceSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT c.customer_id) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= c.signup_date AND o.order_date < c.signup_date + INTERVAL '90 days'))::DOUBLE / count(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS activation_rate FROM customers c WHERE c.signup_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND c.signup_date < DATE '2025-01-01'

commonWrongAnswers.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT o.customer_id)::DOUBLE / count(DISTINCT c.customer_id) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.signup_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND c.signup_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
commonWrongAnswers.whyWrong: Joining orders to customers without the 90-day window or the completed-status filter counts any order ever, not activation within the defined window.
